policy: The Vendor chip is a liquidation recommendation, not a synonym for Low demand. Every priced AH item with a positive NPC SellPrice is checked against a demand-aware minimum Target that covers the 5% AH cut, Hellscream's measured deposit behavior, one failed listing, and a small expected-profit floor for posting effort. Items with no vendor value cannot receive the automatic price-margin signal. NPC-vendor convenience-resale items remain explicitly excluded. The saved manual recommendations remain for unpriced reference rows and unusually narrow buyer cases.

margin_model.comparison_price: Published Target buyout normalized to the row's price basis and largest recommended stack.
margin_model.auction_duration_note: Hellscream charges 20% of the standard deposit while extending auction durations to 4x normal; the shortest listing is therefore approximately two days.
margin_model.failure_rule: Model one listing attempt. On success, subtract the 5% AH cut. On expiration, lose the Hellscream deposit and then vendor the returned stack.
margin_model.decision_rule: Apply Vendor when the expected improvement over vendoring now is less than 25s for one efficiently sized listing. This also guarantees the successful-sale proceeds exceed the direct NPC sell value.
